reason: Two independent origins (an industry lab blog and an academic preprint, three-plus months apart) converge on the same root mechanism: temperature-0 nondeterminism stems from dynamic/load-varying batching (with floating-point non-associativity). Each is primary for the distinct claim it backs (s1 the 80/1000 + 2x->1.6x cost, s2 the selective verify-rollback overhead), both publishers are credible, and they mutually reinforce the underlying mechanism without circular dependence. The set adequately supports the claims.
